# List of Abbreviations {.unnumbered .unlisted}

<!-- [NEW] added: AMC, BGA, CSV, MSB, NMOS, PNG, RS-485, SPI, SPICE (no comments possible inside the table) -->

| **Abbreviation** | **Meaning** |
|:-----------------|:------------|
| AES    | AES Aircraft Elektro/Elektronik System GmbH |
| AMC    | Acceptable Means of Compliance |
| ASIC   | Application-Specific Integrated Circuit |
| BGA    | Ball Grid Array |
| BJT    | Bipolar Junction Transistor |
| CCT    | Correlated Colour Temperature |
| CPE    | Cologne Programmable Element (logic cell of the GateMate FPGA) |
| CRC    | Cyclic Redundancy Check |
| CSV    | Comma-Separated Values |
| DC     | Direct Current |
| EASA   | European Union Aviation Safety Agency |
| EOP    | End of Packet |
| EUROCAE | European Organisation for Civil Aviation Equipment |
| FIFO   | First In, First Out (buffer) |
| FPGA   | Field-Programmable Gate Array |
| FSM    | Finite State Machine |
| GM1, GM2 | GateMate evaluation board 1 and 2 (first and second node of the chain) |
| GPIO   | General-Purpose Input/Output |
| HDL    | Hardware Description Language |
| I/O    | Input/Output |
| IC     | Integrated Circuit |
| ID     | Identification number of a node |
| IEEE   | Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers |
| JSON   | JavaScript Object Notation |
| JTAG   | Joint Test Action Group (test and programming interface) |
| LED    | Light-Emitting Diode |
| LSB    | Least Significant Bit |
| LUT    | Look-Up Table |
| LVDS   | Low-Voltage Differential Signalling |
| MOSFET | Metal–Oxide–Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor |
| MSB    | Most Significant Bit |
| MTBF   | Mean Time Between Failures |
| NMOS   | N-channel MOSFET |
| PC     | Personal Computer |
| PIC    | Microcontroller family of Microchip Technology, master of the AES system |
| PLL    | Phase-Locked Loop |
| PNG    | Portable Network Graphics |
| PWM    | Pulse-Width Modulation |
| RAM    | Random-Access Memory |
| RGB    | Red, Green, Blue |
| RGBW   | Red, Green, Blue, White |
| RS-485 | Recommended Standard 485, differential serial interface |
| RTCA   | Radio Technical Commission for Aeronautics |
| RTL    | Register-Transfer Level |
| RX, TX | Receive, Transmit |
| SOP    | Start of Packet |
| SPI    | Serial Peripheral Interface |
| SPICE  | Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis |
| SRAM   | Static Random-Access Memory |
| TTL    | Transistor–Transistor Logic (logic-level serial signal) |
| UART   | Universal Asynchronous Receiver-Transmitter |
| USART  | Universal Synchronous/Asynchronous Receiver-Transmitter |
| USB    | Universal Serial Bus |
